route_title: Quadratic Chirp 26-Layer Stack with Constrained Perturbation Optimization
compilation_rationale: Resolved HfO2 and SiO2 via registry. Explicit 26-layer chirped stack compiled with ±12% thickness bounds. Gradient optimization targets simultaneous maximization of UV-visible reflectance and IR transmittance. Normal incidence unpolarized light simulated via coherent smatrix over 281 points.
